item.text:
{"source":"import Base

# An eastward sweep sees the board as north/middle/south columns.
type Column is Data:
  Column{north: U32, middle: U32, south: U32}

def Life.stencil(west: Column, center: Column, east: Column) -> U32:
  match west center east:
    case Column{nw, w, sw} Column{n, alive, s} Column{ne, e, se}:
      +ring = (nw + n + ne + w + e + sw + s + se : U32)
      # For a binary center, B3/S23 is three around or three including it.
      Bool.to_u32(Bool.or(
        U32.is_eq(ring, 3),
        U32.is_eq((ring + alive : U32), 3)))

def Life.sweep(
  +row: List<&2, U32>,
  +north: List<&2, U32>,
  +south: List<&2, U32>,
  west: Column
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match row:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case alive <> rest:
      +north2 = {List.tail(&2, U32, north) : List<&2, U32>}
      +south2 = {List.tail(&2, U32, south) : List<&2, U32>}
      +center = {Column{
        Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, north), 0),
        alive,
        Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, south), 0)
      } : Column}
      Life.stencil(
        west,
        center,
        Column{
          Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, north2), 0),
          Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, rest), 0),
          Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, south2), 0)
        }) <>
        Life.sweep(rest, north2, south2, center)

def Life.rows(
  height: Nat,
  +width: Nat,
  +cells: List<&2, U32>,
  above: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match height:
    case 0n:
      Nil{}
    case 1n+rest:
      +row = {List.take(&2, U32, cells, width) : List<&2, U32>}
      +future = {List.drop(&2, U32, cells, width) : List<&2, U32>}
      List.append(&2, U32,
        Life.sweep(
          row,
          above,
          List.take(&2, U32, future, width),
          Column{0, 0, 0}),
        Life.rows(rest, width, future, row))

def step(
  width: U32,
  height: U32,
  cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  Life.rows(
    U32.to_nat(height),
    U32.to_nat(width),
    cells,
    Nil{})

def evolve(
  turns: Nat,
  +width: U32,
  +height: U32,
  cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match turns:
    case 0n:
      cells
    case 1n+rest:
      evolve(rest, width, height, step(width, height, cells))
","hypothesis":"The concrete improvement is to make the two-dimensional computation literally two nested streams: Life.rows rolls south through flat row-major storage while Life.sweep moves east through three aligned row streams. Empty heads become the dead halo through Maybe.default, eliminating the continuation eliminator, the zero-row allocation, the prechunked matrix, and three orchestration declarations. The rule itself compresses because, for a binary center, B3/S23 is exactly `(ring == 3) or (ring + alive == 3)`, collapsing birth and survival into one population identity.","findings":"Confirmed: the round-2 implementation passed all reported runtime, composition, native, and semantic checks. Confirmed actionable style weakness: Halo.with and Rows.cut introduced low-payoff ceremony, while the rule expressed birth and survival as separate cases. This revision removes Halo.with, Rows.cut, Life.row, and Life.enter; replaces materialized row chunking with nested streaming recursion; and applies the equivalent inclusive-population identity. No semantic defect was reported."}
